title: Literature in English — Form 4
description: A fourth-year literature course preparing for the O Level cycle, with original passages, poems and scenes: style and diction, irony and satire, analysing a poem, appreciating an unseen prose passage, dramatic structure and staging, praise poetry and elegy in oral tradition, a review of literary terms and planning an essay under time pressure. Official set texts are not included.
subject: english
